sprite: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent character sprite for a procedurally composed hidden-person game. Create ONE full-body Waldo / Wally cutout on a genuinely transparent background. Slender adult man with brown hair, round black glasses, friendly expression, red-and-white horizontally striped long-sleeve shirt, red-and-white knit hat with red pom-pom, blue trousers, brown shoes. Full head and feet visible, no cane or bag. Relaxed walking pose, viewed from slightly above at a three-quarter angle, facing slightly toward the viewer and right. Crisp contemporary hand-drawn editorial cartoon with clean fine dark outlines, flat clear colors and very subtle shading, coherent anatomy, no blur, no texture grain. Narrow natural silhouette, arms near torso; no large empty area between legs. Match the line detail of a detailed illustrated crowd scene. Isolate the entire figure with clean anti-aliased edges and no halo, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no surrounding objects, no caption, no border, no lettering, no extra characters. Portrait image.
